text:
alex: Heads up — repro'd a perf regression on MQA Llama-2 70B in dedicated yesterday. 99p latency spike for short chat requests. Spike lines up with a kernel roll by deploy-bot; traces show KV cache miss amplification with paged layout :eyes:

deploy-bot: Rolled kernel v2.14.3 -> v2.15.0 to eng-runtime pool at 2026-03-15T03:12Z. No auto rollback.

perf-bot: Profile summary: P99 +2.3x, tokens/s -18%. Hotspots: fused_gqa_kernel (+42%), kv_page_lookup (+60%). Trace link: https://perf.redwood/p/1943

maria: Can you paste the flame/trace? Which model config (num_key_value_heads / kv_dim) were we using for the 70B variant?

alex: We were on MQA with num_key_value_heads: 64, kv_dim: 128. Repro script + trace snippet:
```bash
python tools/repro_latency.py --model llm-70b-mqa --batch 1 --seq 64 --requests 500
# trace: /tmp/trace-1943.json
```

jin: Quick note: the kernel selector now prefers fused_gqa when kv_dim % 64 == 0. For MQA the selector picks fused path but that introduces an extra remap copy when head-count != kernel-expected. That remap is expensive for paged KV (many small pages) -> fragmentation amplification.

sam: Ran a microbench: with kv_page_size=16k and page_count>4 the remap copy latency dominates. If we force kernel_hint=standard_gqa (no remap) p99 goes back to baseline.

maria: Proposed fixes:
1) Adjust kernel selection heuristic to prefer remap-free kernels when page_count > 2 or page_frag_ratio > 0.5.
2) Add model config overrides to align num_key_value_heads to kernel-friendly multiples or add a fast path for kv_dim==64 with MQA. Patch sketch:
```yaml
kernel_hint:
  prefer_remap_free_if:
    page_count_gt: 2
    page_frag_ratio_gt: 0.5
model_overrides:
  llm-70b-mqa:
    num_key_value_heads: 128
    kv_dim: 64
```

alex: Pushed a prototype: https://git.redwood/r/repro-fuse-selection. Canary numbers look promising: p99 -1.9x, tokens/s +12%.

jin: Also add a cheap sampler to measure page_frag_ratio at runtime and expose runtime.kv.fragmentation metric to the console/observability stack. That will help trigger the heuristic dynamically.

perf-bot: Canary run (proto-patch): 1000 requests, config=proto-patch -> P50: 28ms, P95: 120ms, P99: 320ms. Baseline P99 was ~610ms.

sam: One more edge: RoPE scaling (mixtral/mistral families) interacts when kv_dim changes — exponent table alignment/rounding shows up as jitter in the hot path. We must validate that changing kv_dim per-model doesn't alter RoPE table alignment or numerical drift.

maria: Agreed. Adding unit tests to ensure RoPE recompute is tolerant to kv_dim variants and an eval to check logits within epsilon after config change.

alex: Plan: canary -> staged rollout (10/30/60) -> full. Will notify customer-support for potential anomaly alerts.

maria: tagging ops and sdk for alert thresholds and model-config surfaced changes.

sam: LGTM :thumbsup:

jin: TODOs: add kernel_hint logic, runtime fragmentation metric, kv config overrides, unit tests for RoPE/kv_dim, and perf regression alert tuning.

alex: I'll merge this afternoon if CI is green. Thanks all.
